title: Prefix freeness of natural number codes
statement: For natural numbers $a,b$ and Boolean lists $s,t$, if the code for $a$ followed by $s$ equals the code for $b$ followed by $t$, then $a=b$ and $s=t$.
hypotheses_covered: Equality of the code for $a$ followed by $s$ and the code for $b$ followed by $t$
